realism.how: A hand-held VHF/UHF scanning receiver of the kind amateurs and the curious bought or built in the late 1980s: a black plastic Japanese, West German or Czechoslovak set with a short rubber antenna, a keypad and a small LCD, sold from under the counter. Police traffic was meant to be private, which is why the fence sells it.
realism.current: A local sees a black pocket receiver with an LCD and a keypad as a modern gadget of the day, nothing like the olive tin box with fins that the army carried.
